donatingPane_desc1: I didn't like the intrusiveness of ads on this game and felt that getting people to pay for an in-game boost wouldn't bode well in the community as it makes the game feel like a freemium or pay-to-win game.
donatingPane_desc2: However, I like the donation system because there is nothing forcing you to donate other than out of the goodness of people's hearts. If you like the game and want more content faster, I would be happy to put more time towards this game if I felt that it is paying off.
donatingPane_desc4: 'ExileNG' is the name of my Paypal account.
achievementPane_desc: This is where you can see your rank and all of your achievements.
account_desc: When connected, your achievement data will be sent to server database (during auto-saving) to be ranked against all other players.
rankPane_desc: Here are the current player rankings. To be part of it, you just have to register an account then all is automated.
rankPane_nodata: Just waiting for next auto-save to see ranking.
helpPane_desc: This guide will get you from your humble beginnings as a foundling to constructing your first Legendary Structure, and will help you grasp everything you need to do.
help1_desc1: The first thing you can do is start gathering resources. To do this, click the Resources tab near the top left of the screen. This will bring you to the resources display. You can click any of the resources to access its interface, where you can gather the resource yourself by clicking, or you can hire workers or construct workshops to gather those resources for you. While you can hire workers for all three resources, it is recommended to prioritise Iron and Timber in the early stages of the game.
help2_desc1: To unlock scholarship, you must purchase an iron picker, costing 10 Iron and 5 Timber. This is the first step toward idle automation. The Scholarship tab is where you can build academies to produce scholarship for you, and also where you can discover and research new technologies to further your rise to power.
help2_desc2: The first technology you can research is 'Storage Upgrades', which allows you to construct storehouses to hold more of each type of resource. This is necessary when constructing workshops and other tools costs more than 50 of a resource. You can also research 'Basic Vitality Production', which opens up the world of power and advanced workshops to help you gather resources even faster.
help3_desc1: This game has different amounts output by each workshop. This can make balancing your resources hard, especially your Vitality, Charcoal and Timber as they are consumed by other workshops. As a tip, prioritise which resources you should construct workshops for first - in most cases Iron - and produce the 2 Vitality required for an Iron Forge. Don't upgrade everything to workshops at once as you will end up with a Vitality deficit (this is bad as the workshops won't work without Vitality). Build up your Charcoal to power warhorses or increase the number of sun catchers to counter this.
help4_desc1: Well, it isn't called Rise of Empire for nothing. The first thing needed to unlock territorial expansion is to construct a caravan. This is the first large goal that you should aim for as a target. To construct a caravan, you need a lot of resources, which you most likely need to use advanced workshops to get without taking an extremely long time. Secondly, to depart requires 20 war fuel, which can be made in alchemical workshops. These require a large amount of Saltpeter and Charcoal to produce - 20 of each per second per workshop. Once you have 20 War Fuel and have constructed a caravan, press the depart button to unlock marches into new territories and new technologies and ways to gather resources.
settingsPane_desc: You can enable options to change what you want.
importExport_desc: Copy and paste this onto a file somewhere so that you can import it into the game at a later date. You can also use this to create multiple 'savefiles' of the game by storing multiple instances separately.
hardReset_confirm: Are you sure? This is non-reversible after you reset.
aboutPane_desc: This game is made by me, Freddec, as a remake of the original game from Sparticle999. Of course I have the authorization from Sparticle999 to do it. I made this game to improve my skills in VueJS and to get knowledge about incremental games.
about1_desc1: These are links to everything about Rise of Empire outside of the game itself.
about1_desc2: These are links to original game.
vitalityPane_desc: Vitality is the lifeblood of your domain, generated by charcoal warhorses and sun catchers, eventually advancing to arcane and celestial power sources.
vitalityT1_desc: Burns Charcoal to produce a steady source of Vitality for your domain.
vitalityT2_desc: Harnesses the sun's rays to generate Vitality slowly without consuming any resources.
vitalityT3_desc: Burns potent niter from deep salt deposits to satisfy all your Vitality needs.
vitalityT4_desc: Harnesses the volatile essence of cinnabar to create large amounts of Vitality.
vitalityT5_desc: The Magma Dynamo produces Vitality by using magma as war fuel. Because of the extreme temperature of magma, great quantities of Vitality can be produced at once.
vitalityT6_desc: In an alchemical fusion reaction, Vitality is released when two elemental forces are fused into one greater essence. This mirrors the celestial fires that burn within stars and produces immense power.
reservoirPane_desc: You can hold a maximum of 100,000 Vitality. Unlocking reservoirs allows you to increase this.
vitalityS1_desc: When the heavens decreed that Vitality must be stored, these humble clay vessels fell from the sky. Not much, but it's a start.
vitalityS2_desc: The jade-lined structure of these reservoirs allows Vitality to be held within a resonant field around the vessel, storing more than clay alone.
vitalityS3_desc: Improved construction allows for stronger resonance fields and for Vitality to condense within the bronze walls, allowing far more to be stored.
vitalityS4_desc: This reservoir draws upon spirit veins to siphon and hold Vitality from the surrounding land, tapping into the strongest flows first, thus holding much more than previous tiers.
vitalityS5_desc: Using esoteric inscription, the bronze cistern model has been improved at near-invisible scales to allow overlapping Vitality fields, exponentially increasing the amount it can hold.
vitalityS6_desc: Using void-sealing techniques, the reservoir traps Vitality within a pocket of folded space, allowing never-before-seen levels of Vitality storage.
dragonFirePane_desc: Dragon Fire is an alchemical flame that burns hotter than any mortal fire, used by Tier 4 workshops and legendary structures as an extreme power source for your empire.
dragonFireT1_desc: The Fire Keeper channels Vitality into spirit veins to ignite them into Dragon Fire.
dragonFireT2_desc: This alchemical pit converts void essence into Dragon Fire by focusing intensive Vitality bolts into the vapors.
dragonFireT3_desc: Bathing in dragon's breath. What could go wrong?
dragonFireT4_desc: The Celestial Redirector is a colossal observatory built from dark steel, used to channel the power of celestial phenomena toward the earth, to instantaneously transmute the energies into Dragon Fire for collection.
dragonFireS1_desc: Fire Vessels can hold Dragon Fire in a specially warded casing that contains its searing heat.
dragonFireS2_desc: A specially designed vessel which utilises frost crystal and venting techniques to allow more Dragon Fire to be condensed within before the vessel begins to warp from the heat.
dragonFireS3_desc: The void-sealed vessel separates the container itself from the Dragon Fire within, allowing even greater condensation due to the isolating strength of the void.
starIronPane_desc: Star Iron can only be forged from purer forms of Vitality than those created with village craft. Therefore, Dragon Fire is necessary to work this celestial metal.
starIronS1_desc: Double your Star Iron storage size
starIronT1_desc: Construct an automated forge to produce Star Iron without you having to lift a hammer.
starIronT2_desc: The Sky Net uses enchanted fibres forged in highly toxic alchemical baths to become strong enough to physically catch falling stars. Dragon Fire is required to refine the star fragments into usable Star Iron.
starIronT3_desc: Gather Star Iron the old-fashioned way: demolishing barren fiefdoms by firing high-Vitality siege beams at them, then scavenging the debris.
starIronT4_desc: Bypass the need to demolish fiefdoms entirely by summoning your own nebula of creation to forge Star Iron instead!
charcoalPane_desc: Charcoal is a secondary tier resource used by warhorses to produce Vitality for your domain. It is created by burning timber in kilns and forges.
charcoalT1_desc: All the timber that has been put to use is brought here to be cleansed of its charcoal traces and then repurposed.
charcoalT2_desc: Burns timber at very high temperatures to turn it into a finer grade of charcoal than the village kilns can produce.
charcoalT3_desc: Uses magma to smelt timber; the mixture is then cooled, resulting in moderately pure charcoal. The dross is reused in the process.
charcoalT4_desc: This Dragon Fire-fueled furnace burns so hot it turns timber into almost perfectly pure charcoal, ready to be forged into high-grade materials.
charcoalT5_desc: Who knew that a single brush stroke of heavenly calligraphy could transmute this much timber into charcoal?
saltpeterPane_desc: Saltpeter is drawn from deep within the earth and is essential for constructing Tier 2 resource gatherers and alchemical workshops.
saltpeterT1_desc: Dig a small well to draw Saltpeter from the earth below.
saltpeterT2_desc: Salt pumps are much larger than wells and extract Saltpeter on an industrial scale, but they require a lot of Vitality.
saltpeterT3_desc: Niter Fields are vast open tracts, usually found in arid lands where deep saltpeter deposits lie beneath the cracked soil.
saltpeterT4_desc: River Dredges are great floating platforms that extract Saltpeter from beneath riverbeds and lake floors.
saltpeterT5_desc: This alchemical marvel reverses the decay cycle - rather than burning, it creates saltpeter from the charcoal and salt in the air itself.
ironPane_desc: Iron is one of the primary resources. It is used for many things, including storage upgrades, workshop machinery, and most things in your domain.
ironT1_desc: Fashion a pickaxe for your iron picker to scavenge ore from the hills.
ironT2_desc: Iron Forges smelt and work Iron at scale, far beyond what a single picker can manage.
ironT3_desc: Grand Forges extract Iron at colossal speeds, feeding the war machine of your growing domain.
ironT4_desc: Arcane Smelters bend the laws of nature to draw Iron from the earth faster than should be possible.
ironT5_desc: Forges Iron from the very essence of parallel realms where iron is abundant and the mountains bleed ore.
jadePane_desc: Jade is one of the primary resources. It is prized for advanced workshops and for powerful artifacts and components. It becomes more useful as your domain grows.
jadeT1_desc: Fashion an improved pickaxe to mine Jade from mountain veins.
jadeT2_desc: Jade Chisels work jade at scale. Because of the hardness of the stone, they are slower than the iron forge but yield far more precious material.
jadeT3_desc: The Diamond-Tipped Chisel is one of the finest tools in the empire, and as such, can extract Jade faster than anything before it.
jadeT4_desc: Dark Steel Borers are among the strongest tools in the empire, carving through jade deposits faster than any chisel.
jadeT5_desc: This sealed alchemical vessel condenses raw earth essence into jade, creating precious stones at a faster rate than any mine.
timberPane_desc: Timber is one of the primary resources. It is used more often in early game for tools, buildings, and fuel.
timberT1_desc: Fashion an axe for your timber cutter to fell trees for your domain.
timberT2_desc: Iron Saws cut timber (and fingers) far faster than axes and produce a great deal more lumber.
timberT3_desc: This workshop clears entire forests in days. At least you get plenty of timber for your war effort!
timberT4_desc: Creates Timber using old, useless materials found throughout the land by crushing them and packing what remains as densely as possible until it can be used as Timber again.
timberT5_desc: The great evergreen groves span thousands of miles, yielding more than enough timber for your lifetime. Let the next generation worry about running out.
bronzePane_desc: Bronze is vital for the third tier of automatic mining systems. It will be very useful in constructing your first Legendary Structure. Despite being a higher tier resource, it is found mainly on the earth by alloying copper and tin under great heat.
bronzeT1_desc: This torch-forge melts copper and tin into Bronze on a small scale. To construct it, resources beyond the village are required.
bronzeT2_desc: This smelter harnesses coastal winds and intense heat to forge Bronze at a larger scale.
bronzeT3_desc: This relic of war has been repurposed and now looms above coastlines - or what remains of them - melting sand and ore into Bronze.
bronzeT4_desc: This great siege engine roams the wastelands, tearing ore and sand from the earth and forging it into Bronze under intense heat.
bronzeT5_desc: This legendary artifact harnesses the power of distant stars across space and time to alloy Bronze at record speeds. Don't ask why it has a polished wooden frame.
cinnabarPane_desc: Cinnabar is used for arcane power generation because when it is refined, it releases huge amounts of Vitality. For this reason, it is prominent in many advanced workshops and for siege propulsion technology as it is useful for long-range conquest. Unfortunately, it is hard to acquire and it requires a lot of resources to safely contain its volatile essence.
cinnabarT1_desc: Pulverizes cinnabar ore for easy transportation out of deep mine shafts.
cinnabarT2_desc: This mechanism transports blocks of rock from deep underground to the surface so that Cinnabar can be mined more easily.
cinnabarT3_desc: The Refiner increases the purity of cinnabar mined and thus allows more of the cinnabar in ore to be used in your domain.
cinnabarT4_desc: Recycles spent cinnabar to extract a second use from the residue. This greatly increases the amount of Cinnabar you can process per second.
cinnabarT5_desc: This vast complex spans the size of a province, transmuting Cinnabar from common earth elements through forbidden alchemy.
magmaPane_desc: Hard to handle and found only in volcanic depths, Magma is one of the most dangerous resources to acquire.
magmaT1_desc: You can use a specially warded crucible to scoop up magma and store it for later use.
magmaT2_desc: This device extracts magma from volcanic vents automatically and swiftly.
magmaT3_desc: Instead of venturing into volcanoes to find magma, it can be more convenient to forge it yourself with heat and pressure.
magmaT4_desc: A crucible of misery, pouring molten magma forth from crushed rock and ore.
magmaT5_desc: Condenses the celestial fire from the heart of distant stars into liquid magma.
moonSilverPane_desc: Moon Silver is a rare metal found in the Frontier March, far stronger than common iron but far harder to obtain.
moonSilverS1_desc: Double your Moon Silver storage size
moonSilverT1_desc: Hire local laborers from the Frontier March to mine Moon Silver for you.
moonSilverT2_desc: Forges that harness the lighter conditions of the frontier to shape Moon Silver with ease.
moonSilverT3_desc: This great quarry tears open the Frontier March so deeply it can be seen from the heartland.
moonSilverT4_desc: A massive machine that delves deep beneath the earth to find rich veins of Moon Silver near the world's roots.
moonSilverT5_desc: Through arcane alchemy, Moon Silver can now be replicated — no more expeditions required.
niterPane_desc: Niter is an alchemical compound abundant in the Fertile Valley. It powers your domain far more effectively than common war fuel.
niterT1_desc: A simple siphon that draws niter from the valley's natural deposits.
niterT2_desc: A more powerful extractor that pulls niter from deep within the valley's soil.
niterT3_desc: Great vats that brew niter through secret alchemical processes, producing it endlessly.
niterT4_desc: Harness the deep heat of the earth's vents to distill niter from underground gases.
niterT5_desc: An imperial-scale distillery that transmutes base elements into pure niter.
darkSteelPane_desc: Dark Steel is a hard iron found across the Iron Steppe. It is essential for building strong workshops and niter furnaces.
darkSteelS1_desc: Double your Dark Steel storage size
darkSteelT1_desc: Send prospectors to scour the Iron Steppe for dark steel deposits uncovered by the winds.
darkSteelT2_desc: Moon Silver forges powerful enough to smelt dark steel from deep within the steppe's crust.
darkSteelT3_desc: A forge with five working faces, massively increasing the dark steel harvested each cycle.
darkSteelT4_desc: This mighty anvil is said to have been wielded by ancient titans in a forgotten age.
darkSteelT5_desc: The imperial foundry produces dark steel in quantities that would make the titans jealous.
goldPane_desc: Gold is a precious metal found in the Gold Ridge mountains. It is used to build legendary structures and for complex imperial machinery.
goldT1_desc: Niter-powered scouts that search the Gold Ridge for gold deposits.
goldT2_desc: Mines deep into the Gold Ridge to extract gold far more efficiently than prospecting.
goldT3_desc: A vast imperial operation that carves open the Gold Ridge to expose its golden heart.
goldT4_desc: Bending the flow of time itself to refine gold faster than nature intended.
goldT5_desc: Transmutation has advanced to the point where thin air can be turned into gold!
silverPane_desc: Silver is a precious metal most commonly found in the Gold Ridge mountain belt.
silverT1_desc: Scouts that search the Gold Ridge for veins of silver embedded in the rock.
silverT2_desc: Focused beams cut through rock to reveal silver deposits hidden in the mountain's core.
silverT3_desc: A massive press named after a legendary siege weapon, designed to crush ore and extract silver from the Gold Ridge.
silverT4_desc: Arcane forces dissolve the mountain's surface to reveal the silver within.
silverT5_desc: Condenses raw moonlight into pure silver through ancient celestial rites.
spiritVeinPane_desc: Spirit Vein energy flows abundantly through the Spirit Peaks, the sacred mountains at the edge of the known world.
spiritVeinS1_desc: Double your Spirit Vein storage size
spiritVeinT1_desc: Monks travel the Spirit Peaks gathering spirit vein energy to bring back to the domain.
spiritVeinT2_desc: A magnetized relic that draws spirit vein energy toward it, increasing the flow harvested each second.
spiritVeinT3_desc: Built in the heartland, these condensers extract spirit vein from water using a constant supply of vitality.
spiritVeinT4_desc: Deep mining operations that tap into the spirit veins flowing beneath the earth's surface.
spiritVeinT5_desc: Harvest spirit vein energy from the celestial bodies themselves — borrowing without return.
voidEssencePane_desc: Void Essence drifts through the mists of the Cloud Realm, a rare and ethereal substance second only to spirit vein in abundance.
voidEssenceS1_desc: Double your Void Essence storage size
voidEssenceT1_desc: Scouts patrol the Cloud Realm, seeking out pockets rich in void essence for slow extraction.
voidEssenceT2_desc: Massive tankers that hold vast quantities of void essence and transport it from the Cloud Realm back to the domain.
voidEssenceT3_desc: The compressor packs void essence densely into sealed vessels for easy transport back to the heartland.
voidEssenceT4_desc: Flying into the Cloud Realm's deepest mists with great collection vessels — the boldest plan yet!
voidEssenceT5_desc: A contained celestial relic that generates massive amounts of void essence through divine resonance.
frostCrystalPane_desc: Frost Crystals form naturally in the Frozen Wastes and are far superior to any that can be made in the heartland. They are essential for the arcane cooling required by Tier 4 workshops.
frostCrystalS1_desc: Double your Frost Crystal storage size
frostCrystalT1_desc: The simplest tool for harvesting frost crystals — cheap, but slow.
frostCrystalT2_desc: A more effective drill that harvests frost crystals faster, though it requires vitality to operate.
frostCrystalT3_desc: Advanced alchemy allows you to condense high-quality frost crystals from water, rivaling those found in the Frozen Wastes.
frostCrystalT4_desc: An enchanted construct that harvests frost crystals without rest, impervious to the biting cold.
frostCrystalT5_desc: Drains heat so rapidly that safe handling becomes uncertain — but you've mastered it regardless.
scholarshipPane_desc: Scholarship drives the research of new technologies to advance your rise to power.
scholarsoldierT1_desc: Set up a modest study to begin producing scholarship. Each one produces 0.1 scholarship per second.
scholarsoldierT2_desc: Build a proper academy to accelerate your scholarship production. Each one produces 1 scholarship per second.
scholarsoldierT3_desc: An institution of higher learning that greatly advances your scholarship. Each one produces 10 scholarship per second.
scholarsoldierT4_desc: An observatory to study the heavens and draw knowledge from the movements of the stars.
scholarsoldierT5_desc: From the highest tower, beyond the clouds, the mysteries of the cosmos reveal themselves with unparalleled clarity.
researchPane_desc: Research new technologies to unlock more mechanics and advance through the game.
techStorehouse_desc: This will allow you to build storehouse upgrades to increase the maximum amount of each resource you can hold at once.
techVitality1_desc: You will be able to produce vitality from charcoal warhorses using charcoal made from timber in a kiln.
techSaltpeter_desc: Saltpeter fuels more advanced workshops and produces greater vitality than basic methods. Unlocking Saltpeter Processing allows you to extract it from the earth.
techVitality2_desc: Sun catchers harvest vitality from sunlight without consuming fuel, though slower than other methods.
techTier2_desc: Workshop machines produce more resources than manual labor but require a constant supply of vitality to operate.
techDecommission_desc: This allows you to decommission workshops you have already built. Useful when more efficient methods become available, or when you lack the vitality to sustain them.
techWarFuel1_desc: Unlocking caravans allows you to explore beyond your village and opens a whole new field of research.
techWarFuel2_desc: Oxidisation is a more efficient process for producing war fuel.
techWarFuel3_desc: Hydrazine is a compound derived from niter that accelerates war fuel production in a Hydrazine Catalyst workshop.
techScholarship2_desc: Researching this will drastically increase your scholarship production.
techScholarship3_desc: Researching this will grant access to the third tier of scholarship production, yielding far more than previous tiers.
techScholarship4_desc: Researching this unlocks the fourth tier of scholarship production, creating ten times as much as the previous tier.
techVitalityStorage1_desc: Tier 1 Reservoirs improve the amount of vitality you can store at once.
techVitalityStorage2_desc: Tier 2 Reservoirs improve the amount of vitality you can store at once.
techVitalityStorage3_desc: Tier 3 Reservoirs improve the amount of vitality you can store at once.
techVitalityStorage4_desc: Tier 4 Reservoirs improve the amount of vitality you can store at once.
techDragonFire1_desc: This allows you to transmute vitality and spirit vein into Dragon Fire.
techDragonFire2_desc: This research unlocks the second tier of Dragon Fire production, the Flame Pit.
techDragonFireStorage1_desc: Fire Vessels increase the limit on dragon fire you can store at once.
techDragonFireStorage2_desc: Tier 2 Fire Vessels store dragon fire more efficiently but are significantly larger and require more resources to construct.
techAlchemy1_desc: This ancient technology not only lets you create existing resources, but allows you to forge new and otherwise unobtainable elements, such as Star Iron.
techStarIron0_desc: Star Iron is among the rarest resources in the world — an artificial metal. All naturally occurring Star Iron has long since been claimed. Now, the only way to obtain it is to forge it in workshops from vitality.
techStarIron1_desc: Research an automated method to forge Star Iron so production continues even in your absence.
techStarIron2_desc: Research a more efficient method of obtaining star iron than forging it from raw vitality.
techGrandFormation1_desc: Grand Rings produce vast amounts of vitality by surrounding the imperial seat with vitality-harvesting formations.
techGrandFormation2_desc: Grand Swarms encircle the seat of power with rings of harvesters, while the Grand Sphere encompasses it entirely, generating enough vitality to march into the dominion beyond.
techShadowNetwork1_desc: Shadow agents infiltrate your workshops and amplify the production of one resource, doubling it every ten networks. In exchange for rare charcoal-based materials, the blueprints shall be yours.
upgradeTier2_desc: Make your workshop machines produce even more resources than before. This upgrade doubles their output for each unit of vitality consumed.
upgradeVitality1_desc: Upgrading Warhorse Technology makes charcoal warhorses produce 4 vitality per second instead of 2.
upgradeVitality2_desc: Upgrading Solar Technology makes sun catchers produce 3 vitality per second instead of 1.5.
boostProduction_desc: Resource Efficiency increases the income of resources by 1%/s per purchase.
boostScholarship_desc: Scholarship Efficiency increases scholarship production by 2% per purchase.
boostVitality_desc: Vitality Efficiency decreases the vitality consumption of all workshops by 1%/s per purchase.
boostVitalityStorage_desc: Reservoir Efficiency improves the storage capabilities of your reservoirs by 1% per upgrade.
caravanPane_desc: Build a caravan to explore and claim new territories beyond your village.
caravan1_desc: To depart with the caravan, it must first be constructed.
caravan2_desc: Departing the caravan will unlock territorial expansion, marching, and other fiefdoms. This requires a scout for navigation.
warFuelPane_desc: War Fuel is produced in workshops and is used to launch caravans on their expeditions and to march to distant territories and fiefdoms.
warFuelT1_desc: War Fuel Workshops are used to produce war fuel for caravans automatically.
warFuelT2_desc: Oxidisation Chambers produce war fuel faster and more efficiently than workshops.
warFuelT3_desc: These speed up the chemical reactions needed to produce war fuel by using compounds such as niter.
frontierMarch_desc: A border territory beyond the village, rich in Moon Silver. The silver deposits here are remnants of ancient geological forces, far stronger than common iron and essential for forging advanced war machines.
barrenReach_desc: A desolate wasteland with little value. It is not worth marching into its interior as no valuable materials can be found upon its barren surface.
fertileValley_desc: A lush valley rich in niter and alchemical compounds. The extreme heat of its depths yields potent reagents, allowing you to develop new forms of power generation.
ironSteppe_desc: A vast steppe covered in dark iron deposits. Beneath the rust-colored surface lies titanium, a metal that enables the construction of methane forges and silicon refineries.
goldRidge_desc: A mountain ridge rich in gold and silver veins. Among its countless peaks and crags, rare metals can be harvested far more easily than within the heartland.
legendFortress_desc: A great fortress built by an ancient civilization, housing legendary blueprints. What lies within is not fully known, but carvings on ancient artifacts depict something similar. They say that there, you will learn about an almost supernatural Celestial Will, commanding over the realm. They say that it will teach you many things on your journey to imperial conquest.
spiritPeaks_desc: Sacred mountain peaks where spirit veins flow. An elevated fortress would be ideal to harvest spirit essence from the peaks' atmosphere. Make it so!
cloudRealm_desc: A misty highland realm where void essence drifts. We struck gold! Figuratively at least. This vast and enigmatic territory, second only to the Spirit Peaks in scale, is shrouded in perpetual mist. You can find Void Essence here.
silentExpanse_desc: A vast empty territory with fierce winds. Its composition is much like that of the other highland territories, mainly composed of hydrogen and helium. Because of this, it is not worth exploring to get the same resources as in the Cloud Realm and Spirit Peaks.
deepAbyss_desc: A treacherous deep territory with storms and chaos. There are huge storms and winds more violent than any other in the realm. There is not much there but methane, hydrogen and helium.
frozenWastes_desc: An icy wasteland where frost crystals form naturally. With large quantities of frost crystal being extremely expensive to create in the heartland, it is actually cheaper to harvest them from the Frozen Wastes!
imperialAcademy0_desc: Vast stretches of wilderness separate lonely outposts floating in a centuries-long orbit around the imperial seat. Still, there is something of great importance to be found here.
imperialAcademy1_desc: Welcome to our home. Our order is dedicated to scholarly progress and interacting with others. If you wish to trade with us, we can provide you blueprints for technology that few in the realm have ever seen.
legendFortressPane_desc: As you enter the revolving pyramids, floating through the void, you feel a small tug on your war engine as it gravitates towards an opening doorway in the side of the lowest section. Exiting your war engine, you experience the artificial gravity and walk to the large hallway ahead. Adorning the walls are four huge paintings of monolithic structures in the corners of the room with descriptions underneath. At the far end of the room is a giant door, closed without any indication of being able to open. You feel that there is a higher being watching over you as you walk through the room. NB: You must activate the legendary structures after constructing them to receive their effects.
legendTreasure0_desc: The first painting depicts a large, shiny structure and the plaque reads: 'While I am rich beyond comparison, I still value adding precious resources to my collection. In return for your Jade, Silver, and Gold, I will teach you about something that lies within your own territory, allowing you to find a rare resource and dangerous element previously unfound.'
legendVital0_desc: A pulsating image depicts a huge pyramid, with sparks of lightning. What could the Celestial Will want now? 'Having drained many stars of their vitality, I want a legendary structure built in honor of the vitality I have taken from the realm with my mighty power. In return for constructing this, I will grant you ways to generate a form of power no mortal has been able to harness before.'
legendScholar0_desc: A green-tinted picture shows the inside of some arcane mechanism. 'With my scholarly superiority over anyone in the cosmos, I want a monument dedicated to the advanced mechanisms I control. As a reward, I will teach you about automated machines and give you the ability to make more advanced resource gatherers.'
legendCelestial0_desc: A blazing red portrait depicts a futuristic set of machines. 'You have accomplished much so far, but now you face constructing a great structure to last generations. For my next monument, I will gift you with a new type of machine only seen in legend. Star iron machines use the vitality installed in them to convert dragon fire into raw power useful in extracting resources.'
legendTreasure1_desc: The Celestial Will is pleased with its new riches and offers you the ability to produce scouts, which patrol the realm and can find new resources. Activating this legendary structure will teach you about Cinnabar, how to extract it and how to harness it. Learning about this rare substance found deep within your territory will unlock alchemical power, a new way to create vitality.
legendVital1_desc: Now with a pyramid of vitality at its disposal, the Celestial Will grants you some of its technology to produce electricity. Activating this legendary structure will allow you to harness the power of Lava, a new method of vitality generation.
legendScholar1_desc: Proud of its new monument, the Celestial Will teaches you the ways of automated machines and advanced gathering of resources. Activating this legendary structure will allow you to construct Tier 3 Machines, a much more effective method of collecting resources.
legendCelestial1_desc: The Celestial Will, watching its newly built legendary structure, offers you the possibility for a new wave of machines that best any before them. Activating this legendary structure gives you the ability to construct 4th Tier resource gathering machines, which are better and more efficient than anything before it.
legendBeacon_desc: In the center of the room, you see a smouldered signal beacon, lying on the floor. A plaque next to it says 'Original Beacon Relay between my first two dominions'. A loud voice booms again from the speakers at the far corners of the floor: 'This is one of my most prized memorabilia, reminding me of the first message I sent between dominions. I will be elated if you repair this for me, and in return, I will help you on your mission to conquer the realm.' For rebuilding the Beacon Legend, you will be able to talk and listen to distant peoples in other territories and determine whether there is sentient life beyond your borders.
legendWarship_desc: Up on the second floor, you find a disarray of broken machines and scattered parts on the floor. You can reassemble what seems to be a war engine lying next to you. The booming voice of the Celestial Will comes over the speakers in the room: 'Greetings, friend. As you can see, this floor has largely fallen into disorder. If you fix it for me, you will be handsomely rewarded. Your first task is to repair the legendary structure to your right. It used to be a war engine, but I am not sure where the pieces are. You may need additional research to construct this once more, but I am sure you will figure it out just fine.' For rebuilding the Warship Legend, you will discover advanced technologies where you can learn how to march beyond your small territory.
legendChaosGate_desc: In the corner of the floor, you see a faintly glowing, large canister, propped up against the walls. The announcing message plays after pressing a red button next to it: 'This was my first chaos essence tank for the maiden voyage of The Grand March, on my first campaign to another dominion. For repairing it and bringing back the memories, I will teach you about your own chaos essence production to war fuel your dreams of expanding beyond your small piece of the realm.' For rebuilding the Chaos Gate Legend, you will gain access to chaos essence production and storage.
legendPortal_desc: An obsidian-looking giant-sized frame stands out in the room, mounted on the far wall of the floor. Its plaque reads: 'This is the pathway to the third and final floor of my mystical Legend Fortress. It takes many resources to activate it, but once completed, will grant you access to the Heaven Gate Room: The only way you will find your way out of this pathetic territory and conquer the realm.' Activating the Portal will allow you to go through it to get to the Third Floor of the Legend Fortress, detached from the rest of the tetrahedral monolith.
legendFloor3Pane_desc: The final floor, despite being the smallest of the three, appears to be the trophy room, displaying an imposing control panel and a large table.
legendHeavenGate_desc: For rebuilding the Heaven Gate, you will be able to march beyond your own territory and explore the outer reaches of the realm.
techDragonFire0_desc: Dragon fire being a state of extreme vitality, it can be used as a storage of large amounts and provides the ability to use higher tier machines and transmutations.
techAlchemy0_desc: The Alchemy Furnace is a technology only dreamt about in the heartland. Here, it is a reality. You can turn vitality and dragon fire into regular resources, or, with large amounts, you can turn it into rare ones, which you are unable to find and have to make to acquire.
techGrandFormation0_desc: This technology, unheard of previously, is now a reality, thanks to those in the Imperial Academy. The Grand Sphere can provide much vitality for millions of years, but at what cost? NB: Formation Cores' costs are based on the number you have, and are thus reset, when you use them all, or lowered if only partially spent.
alchemyPane_desc: The Alchemy Furnace is a technology only dreamt about in the heartland. Here, it is a reality. You can turn vitality and dragon fire into regular resources, or, with large amounts, you can turn it into rare ones, which you are unable to find and have to make to acquire.
grandFormationPane_desc: This technology, unheard of previously, is now a reality, thanks to those in the Imperial Academy. The Grand Sphere can provide much vitality for millions of years, but at what cost? NB: Formation Cores' costs are based on the number you have, and are thus reset, when you use them all, or lowered if only partially spent.
formationCore_desc: These mega-structures cannot possibly be built in one piece. They must be created from small cores and forged together around the imperial seat.
grandFormationT1_desc: The Grand Ring is a ring of formations encircling your domain that can produce 5,000 vitality per second. It requires 50,000 war fuel in total to put the cores in place.
grandFormationT2_desc: The Grand Swarm is an array of formation stations encircling your domain, and once built, it can produce 25,000 vitality per second. However, it requires 250,000 war fuel in total to put the cores in place.
grandFormationT3_desc: The Grand Sphere is a monolithic structure completely surrounding the imperial seat. It will allow for enough vitality to march beyond your borders and finally escape this territory. It will produce 1,000,000 vitality per second.
shadowNetwork_desc: Shadow agents infiltrate and amplify your production. Every ten shadow networks double the output of one resource. They are capable of copying other machines' forms and taking up their role in resource production. You can select one resource to be amplified, and change it at any time.
scoutPane_desc: This is where you send scouts to learn about distant fiefdoms. NB: The nearest fiefdom, Alpha Centauri is 4.3 Li away. 1 Imperial Range Scanner will not get you there.
scoutT1_desc: A huge problem with the theory of long-range dominion marches is on the verge of being broken. Make it happen with this upgrade. This is a one time upgrade, increasing your marching range by 5 Li.
scoutT2_desc: The Celestial Will grants you the technology to discover fiefdoms across the dominion by using the Imperial Range Scanner. Each one increases the marching range by 1 Li.
warEnginePane_desc: This is where you can construct your war engine for the march to distant fiefdoms.
warEngine_desc: The War Engine carries your armies to distant fiefdoms across the dominion.
armor_desc: Armor plating protects against hostile forces and harsh conditions on the march.
warhorse_desc: Warhorses combine chaos essence with matter for propulsion across the dominion.
banner_desc: Banners mark your army's standard for swift deployment and disciplined formation.
chaosEssencePane_desc: Your war fuel for dominion marches is produced here. Unfortunately, you can only handle 100k Chaos Essence per Fiefdom as it is incredibly volatile.
chaosEssenceT1_desc: This powerful reactor can turn high-vitality dragon fire into the most efficient war fuel we can imagine.
soldierT1_desc: Scout patrols are the smallest and fastest units and cost the least of all. Despite their seemingly little worth, they are important in battle and in numbers, can be deadly.
soldierT2_desc: Larger than scouts, the Vanguard Brigade is among the lighter side of warfare. They have more power than scouts, but are significantly slower.
soldierT3_desc: The Iron Guard is a mid-sized unit with decent speed, given its other attributes. What it lacks in defense, it makes up for in power and speed and is a good unit to populate your armies with.
soldierT4_desc: The Battle Lord Division is a costly investment, but pays off with a balanced mix of power, defense and speed. It is a high-end unit, both in terms of attributes and cost.
soldierT5_desc: The Imperial Guard is a Defense-heavy unit, but can still pack a punch with its large attack force. The main downside is the slow speed, dragging the army's maneuverability down.
dominionCrimsonLotusPane_desc: A ruthless faction with a fierce anger towards the ones in power, most notably, the Jade Throne. They are incessant in their opposition and focus their whole force towards attacking their enemies. Because of this, what they offer comprises mostly of upgrades tending towards a more active gameplay.
dominionJadeThronePane_desc: The ruling dynasty of the known world and the faction most focused on keeping things as they are. Opposed to change, they have an authoritarian regime and offer mainly upgrades concerning legendary structures such as the Grand Formations.
dominionAzureAcademyPane_desc: The Azure Academy is a scholarship loving society, proud of all advances in knowledge and always looking to the future. They fight for the truth and are welcoming to anyone who shares their beliefs.
dominionGoldenCartelPane_desc: This merchant cartel has grown powerful across the dominion and is inspired by profits, with allies to those who can support their aims. Upgrades offered focus on passive gains, with a large amount of automation.
dominionIronLegionPane_desc: The Iron Legion is an expansionist centred faction, with a goal of conquest over the dominion. They often play both sides of a conflict, hoping to gain from the chaos. They offer improvements in your marches, including war engine construction and dominion travel.
mandatePane_desc1: You have built an empire spanning the known world. But as you gaze upon your domain, you wonder what more could be achieved.
mandatePane_desc2: The Celestial Will speaks: 'You have come far, but your mortal life draws to a close. Yet you have not fulfilled the destiny I foresaw.'
mandatePane_desc3: 'Despite falling short of my expectations, your loyalty earns you another chance at life through the Mandate of Heaven.'
mandatePane_desc4: 'You may be reborn when the time comes and sacrifice is necessary. Each reincarnation, your empire will grow greater than before.'
mandatePane_desc5: 'You will start anew, but in exchange for your devotion, I grant your next self the wisdom of past lives and the Mandate of Heaven — the divine right to rule.'
mandate_desc: Here, you can see how much Mandate you have acquired and the earnings you will receive upon reincarnation.
dmWonders_desc: You get Mandate for the floors of the Legend Hall that you complete. It is likely you will have achieved all of these in your first run before reincarnating. You get 4 Mandate for every floor completed, but 2 for the last floor (only one legend).
dmSpheres_desc: For building a grand formation in your home fiefdom and thus completing it, you get 15 Mandate. For every formation built in another fiefdom, you gain 5 Mandate.
dmResearches_desc: For every 25 Research Efficiencies in any of the repurchaseable researches, you will get 2 Mandate.
dmRank_desc: For every achievement rank attained, you will get 2 Mandate. Due to the easy difficulty in the first few achievement ranks, this will be your primary source of Mandate early in a run.
dmSwarms_desc: One of the more complex systems, your Mandate gained from networks is judged on an old mathematical sequence: The triangle numbers. You will get 1 Mandate for passing each triangular number of networks. For example: 1,3,6,10,15,21...
rebirth_desc: To be reborn is a sacred undertaking. You start afresh, carrying the wisdom and experience of past lives, achieving greater heights each time. You keep unspent Mandate and all upgrades. Each reincarnation makes you more powerful than the last. NB: You cannot reincarnate without a Grand Formation.
rebirth_confirm: Are you sure? This is non-reversible after you reset and save.
mandateCrimsonLotusPane_desc: A ruthless faction with a fierce anger towards the ones in power, most notably, the Jade Throne. They are incessant in their opposition and focus their whole force towards attacking their enemies. Because of this, what they offer comprises mostly of upgrades tending towards a more active gameplay.
upgradeGain_desc: Increase all gain buttons to 20 per click instead of 1. Improves relationship by 3.
upgradeStorage1_desc: Start with 6,400 max-storage on all resources every reincarnation. (Does not affect if already over 6,400). Improves relationship by 6.
upgradeStorage2_desc: All Storehouses no longer cost 100% of the main resource, but instead, 75%. Improves relationship by 14.
techVitalityStorage6_desc: Unlock Void Batteries. Improves relationship by 15.
upgradeStorage3_desc: Opens a rift in the fabric of the multiverse, allowing you to store your resources in another dimension past your default capacity, up to 10x, at a 95% decrease in production after filling up. Improves relationship by 26.
mandateJadeThronePane_desc: The ruling dynasty of the known world and the faction most focused on keeping things as they are. Opposed to change, they have an authoritarian regime and offer mainly upgrades concerning legendary structures such as the Grand Formations.
techDragonFire3_desc: Unlock the Dragon Kiln. Improves relationship by 4.
upgradeLegend1_desc: All Legendary Structures on the First Floor receive a 15% price reduction for activation. Improves relationship by 10.
upgradeLegend2_desc: All Legendary Structures on the Second and Third Floor receive a 20% price reduction for activation. Improves relationship by 15.
upgradeLegend3_desc: First floor legends are mysteriously pre-built for you every run. They still need to be activated. Improves relationship by 11.
techDragonFire4_desc: Unlock the Heaven's Forge Refinery. Improves relationship by 17.
techDragonFireStorage3_desc: Unlock the Dragon Vessel containment system. Improves relationship by 12.
autoAlchemy_desc: Activate it on an alchemy resource and have that resource be transmuted according to frequency. Improves relationship by 17.
mandateAzureAcademyPane_desc: The Azure Academy is a scholarship loving society, proud of all advances in knowledge and always looking to the future. They fight for the truth and are welcoming to anyone who shares their beliefs.
upgradeScholarship1_desc: Start with 20 T1 Academies on reincarnation. Improves relationship by 3.
upgradeScholarship2_desc: T2+ Academies are 20% cheaper with this upgrade. Improves relationship by 12.
techScholarship5_desc: Unlock the Grand Scholar's Observatory. Improves relationship by 14.
upgradeVitalityBoost_desc: Increase Vitality Efficiency research cap to 50% instead of 25%. Improves relationship by 25.
mandateGoldenCartelPane_desc: This merchant cartel has grown powerful across the dominion and is inspired by profits, with allies to those who can support their aims. Upgrades offered focus on passive gains, with a large amount of automation.
upgradeTier1_desc: All Tier 1 workshops on every resource (in resources tab) are 10% cheaper. Improves relationship by 4.
techVitalityStorage5_desc: Unlock the fifth tier of batteries for all your vitality storage needs. Improves relationship by 17.
multiBuy_desc: Unlock powers of mass purchasing and decommissioning! Improves relationship by 20.
boostCapital_desc: For every resource at max storage, every other resource gets a 5% production boost. Improves relationship by 18.
techTier5_desc: Gain access to the research for fifth tier of resource workshops. These are unlocked after activating the T4 Star Iron Legend. Improves relationship by 20.
mandateIronLegionPane_desc: The Iron Legion is an expansionist centred faction, with a goal of conquest over the dominion. They often play both sides of a conflict, hoping to gain from the chaos. They offer improvements in your marches, including war engine construction and dominion travel.
upgradeWarFuel1_desc: Produce 100% more war fuel in workshops (T1). Improves relationship by 7.
upgradeWarEngine_desc: Caravan Parts Cost 35% less. Improves relationship by 28.
techStarIron3_desc: Unlock the Realm Smasher building. Improves relationship by 29.
techStarIron4_desc: Unlock the Ethereal Forge building. Improves relationship by 36.
mandateCelestialWillPane_desc: This faction is shrouded in mystery. While not much is known, a great sense of power overlooks the whole dominion, seemingly above the other 5 factions and their 'petty' squabbles. The upgrades from your loyalty to the Celestial Will are not constrained to a type and vary greatly.
boostMandate_desc: This adds a 1% boost to all resources (including scholarship) for each Mandate you have not spent. Improves relationship by 20.
techShadowNetwork0_desc: Imagine shadow agents, but worse. These operatives amplify your production by double every ten shadow networks! They are capable of copying other workshops' forms and taking up their role in resource production. You can select one resource to be amplified, and change it at any time. NB: Shows up in the Imperial Court when unlocked. Improves relationship by 17.
upgradeFaction_desc: Increases All Factions' Relationship by 20. Improves relationship by 20.
notEnoughInputCount: No production, not enough input count
notEnoughInputStorage: No production, not enough input storage
toastAchievement_text: You have reached a new achievement.
toastAutoSave_text: Your save data has been stored in localStorage on your computer.
toastSpySuccess_text: Your scouts have gathered intelligence on the fiefdom.
toastSpyFailed_text: Your scouts were captured by the enemy.
toastInvadeSuccess_text: You have conquered the fiefdom and gained production boosts.
toastInvadeFailed_text: The enemy forces were too strong. Your army was destroyed.
toastAbsorbSuccess_text: The fiefdom has been peacefully annexed.
spy_desc: This is where you can send scouts to find information about your enemies' armies. At the first level, you will be able to see the number of digits in the enemy army statistics, with the second revealing the first digit in all three stats and each successive level will reveal the next digit.
invade_desc: Here, you can activate soldiers within your army and attempt to conquer the faction's fiefdom. Your reputation with them affects how prepared they are for a possible conquest. The fiefdom's army statistics take this into account already, so no extra calculation is needed. Conquering has a bad effect on your reputation with the faction in question, reducing it by 10 for a successful conquest. However, due to their large ego, they take pity on failed attempts and reputation is not changed in the result of a loss.
absorb_desc: Annexing is the simplest way of conquering a fiefdom. Unfortunately, you must be on good terms with the faction in control, with over 60 reputation with them. When annexing, you will lose 5 reputation in doing so, which is half the amount you would lose in a conquest.
